issues.title: Use of SELECT *
issues.problem: Using SELECT * can lead to performance issues and potential security risks if unnecessary columns are included in the result set.
issues.fix: SELECT merchant_id, merchant_name, category, city, onboarded_date FROM DIM_MERCHANT;

issues.title: Table name casing
issues.problem: Table names should be consistently cased to avoid confusion and potential errors.
issues.fix: SELECT merchant_id, merchant_name, category, city, onboarded_date FROM sigma_analytics.dim_merchant;
